name: Cube Assisted Raymarching
definition: A technique similar to sphere-assisted raymarching but stores the size of the largest possible cube around each empty cell instead of a sphere. This is faster to compute but slightly suboptimal for step size.
summary: Cube Assisted Raymarching is a distance-field technique storing the largest empty cube size per voxel, offering significantly faster preprocessing than Sphere Assisted Raymarching at the cost of step optimality.
